data.title: Assembly guide
data.description: The complete step-by-step assembly guide for the Lumi refractor.

data.title: What you learn by building it
data.description:
Lumi is built module by module, and each part matches a step along the path of light:

  • Lens barrel and objective: the 50 mm lens (achromatic doublet) collects light and forms the image, 200 mm further on.
  • Baffle: blocks stray light that would reduce contrast.
  • Optical tube: keeps the objective and eyepiece at the right distance.
  • 1.25" focuser: used to bring the image into focus.
  • Prism diagonal: redirects the light for comfortable viewing.
  • 20 mm eyepiece: magnifies the image formed by the objective, here about 10 times (200 ÷ 20).

Each module only fits one way: you understand what each part does as you put it in place, without instructions.

data.title: Filter holder
data.description: The Lumi pack includes a filter holder compatible with standard 1.25" filters. You can install different types of filters according to your observation needs: moon filter to reduce glare when observing the Moon, or UHC filter to enhance nebula contrast for example.

reviews.author: Phil P.
reviews.title: Far from being a toy!
reviews.content: I wasted no time putting it together, it was really easy, and I first tried it out as a spotting scope, but I was truly blown away by the quality when I pointed it at the moon, it's far from being a toy! A beautiful object, and a very educational one too, though that's far from its only quality. Thanks for agreeing to engrave my name on it, and congratulations on designing this little telescope: it's fantastic! 😍🙏

reviews.author: Maxime G.
reviews.title: A wonderful birthday gift for my daughter… and a little for me too!
reviews.content: A wonderful birthday gift for my daughter… and a little for me too, I'll admit! The assembly is very well thought out and makes it easy to understand how the telescope works. Assembling it as a family was a real moment of togetherness. The images are magnificent, very sharp, and the design is truly superb. Both educational and elegant, it immediately makes you want to observe the sky. We can't wait for the next starry nights!
